description: This is a modern, white rectangular chandelier. It features a flat top fixture from which three slender rods hang down. Suspended below the rods is a rectangular base adorned with numerous vertical, cylindrical elements. These elements appear to be lights or decorative tubes arranged in a dense, linear fashion across the underside of the fixture. The overall design is minimalist and geometric, with clean lines and a monochromatic color scheme. The shadows cast suggest it's a pendant light designed to illuminate a space from above.
